hook_text: 3 + 2³ × √25. Is it 55 or 43? Most people get it wrong.
clip_script: Calculate 3 plus two cubed times the square root of twenty-five. Powers and roots: two cubed is eight; the square root of twenty-five is five. The expression is now 3 plus 8 times 5. Multiplication next: forty. Addition last: 43. The common wrong answer is fifty-five, from working left to right.
visual_style: The expression on a chalkboard; the power and root glow and collapse into 8 and 5; then 8 × 5 collapses into 40; a red 55 is crossed out beside a green 43.
pacing: Hook with two answers, then three collapses, reveal.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to master brackets, powers and roots together.
